checked_obligation: Verify that n_k=(y_k+1)/2 is a positive integer and that the quadratic (2) has the two stated integer roots.
reason: By n7, y_k is positive and odd, so n_k=(y_k+1)/2 is a positive integer. Equations (4) and (5) give t_k^2=3y_k^2-2=12n_k^2-12n_k+1, which is the discriminant of (2). This quantity is odd, so t_k is odd; hence 4n_k-1±t_k is even. The quadratic formula therefore gives the two integer roots m=(4n_k-1±t_k)/2 exactly as stated.
